From: Lisa Connor <finance@cloudscale.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudscale.io
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 17:24:00 +00:00
Subject: Invoice delivery preference & PO 8472 (CloudScale)

Hi Rishi,

We just received the quote and have approved PO 8472 for the pilot. A few quick questions so our AP team can process invoices:

- Do you issue a consolidated monthly invoice or individual invoices per usage event? We prefer one consolidated invoice on the 1st of each month.
- We operate in the Netherlands and will likely need reverse-charge (VAT) processing. Can you invoice net under reverse-charge if we provide a VAT certificate?
- Where should the invoice be sent? Our options: billing@cloudscale.io (email) or via our procurement portal (we can ingest PDFs). Which do you recommend?
- Payment method: SEPA bank transfer is preferred. Do you support direct bank transfer only or can we pay by card as a backup?

Attached: PO_8472.pdf (order confirmation).

Thanks — if you can loop in whoever handles onboarding for billing that would be great.

Best,
Lisa
Finance Manager
CloudScale Inc.
[Attachment: PO_8472.pdf]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Connor <finance@cloudscale.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery preference & PO 8472 (CloudScale)

Hi Lisa — thanks for the details and the PO. Quick answers and options:

- Invoicing cadence: We can do a consolidated monthly invoice issued on the 1st (covers prior month usage). That matches our standard enterprise flow.

- VAT / reverse-charge: Yes — if you provide an EU VAT certificate and confirm you are registered for reverse-charge, we can issue invoices net of VAT and include the necessary reverse-charge language. Please attach the VAT certificate and your VAT number.

- Delivery options: two paths: 1) Email to billing@cloudscale.io — we can send a PDF copy to that address for immediate ingestion; OR 2) Redwood Billing Portal — recommended for long-term customers because it provides automated delivery, PO matching, SFTP/Dropbox export, and audit history. The portal also supports sending the same invoice to multiple addresses. If you want automated ingestion into your procurement system, portal is easier. If you prefer a human-to-human fallback, email is fine.

- Payment methods: SEPA bank transfer is fine. We support SEPA (preferred), ACH (US), and card for immediate/one-off payments. For SEPA, we'll include our banking details on the invoice.

Next steps I need from you to finalize setup:
1) Confirm billing email(s) exactly as they should appear on invoices (e.g., billing@cloudscale.io).
2) Attach VAT certificate and provide VAT registration number.
3) Confirm preferred invoice delivery (Email + Portal archive OR Portal only).

I've attached a short guide to the portal (Redwood_Billing_Portal_Instructions.pdf) — if you want, Marissa here can create the portal account and add billing@cloudscale.io.

Cheers,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Billing_Portal_Instructions.pdf]
